entries.note: baseline snapshot at adoption of skill-provenance/v1
inject shared interaction-policy v1 managed region
add portable audience, topic, lifecycle-stage, and maturity metadata, and make the bundled analyzer command plugin-location independent

replace the bootstrap-CI significance gate (a non-negative spread whose CI clears zero even under pure noise) with a label-shuffled permutation null, and report a per-knob effect instead of copying the run-level heldout delta onto every knob

State that --objective must exactly match the trial's metric key (e.g. exec_accuracy on text2SQL runs), and that an empty/all-directional importance.json means insufficient variation, not 'no knob matters'.
